chunks: They said: 'O our people, we have heard a Book revealed after Moses, confirming what was before it, guiding to the truth and to a straight path.'
ai.seo_question: What do the Banu Israel say about the Book revealed after Moses?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-A'raf, the Banu Israel exhort their community to embrace the Quran as the final confirmation (Musaddiq) of the Torah, emphasizing its role in rectifying previous interpretations. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi, highlight this verse as evidence of the Quran's continuity with earlier divine revelations while asserting its supremacy in guiding humanity to the 'Straight Path' (Tariq Mustaqim).
